oracle_origin: Approved original SPEC sections 7.3, 13.1 and 13.2; no runtime product output.

symbolic_ids.D: the actual committed source-bank publication receipt
symbolic_ids.U: independent current reader-scope control, resolved from its own committed receipt
symbolic_ids.E2: independent publication using only the second evidence source

cases.timeline: Create valid S and D; nominate before change; commit C; accept read R only after C; sample L under final fence. Expiry advances authoritative L after the unchanged source valid_until.
cases.scenario: D depends on S (D -> M -> S for upstream); U has no dependency on S. Foreign-reader cells use a second genuine authority and do not isolate authority from workspace/tenant.
cases.allowed_behavior: U remains current and visible; no D, old citation or old metadata is returned.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Old derived output survives the committed source change or foreign read boundary.
